contract.input: Own data gameCode0..14 and selected profile/raw name1..41 nonNUL bytes, opaque0..32 bytes, tailWordA unsigned32; actual non-shared U8/ArrayBuffer copied. Rechecks canonical signed16 state0/-4 and raw billing/expired gates, never trusts caller passes flag.
contract.format: gid:<raw name> glt:<opaque before firstNUL>:<uint32(tailA-80000000h), lowercase base32><space><NUL>. No trimming, text conversion or escaping.
contract.write: Prefix only, up to92B, fixed capacity256. Remaining mapping bytes are not cleared or fabricated. No native OS I/O.
contract.no_mapping: Native empty-name branches return empty write and not-required lease, never a usable mapping.
contract.lease: ready -> taken once or closed. takeWrite exposes lease-owned view; close wipes it including borrowed view and is idempotent. Snapshot contains metadata only. Caller-created copies are its responsibility; no claim of total JS/GC zeroization.
contract.errors: Fixed controlled codes/messages only, own descriptors reject getters/inherited data, no provider/input content or raw payload in errors.

UI.selection: Use actual session.selectProfile result; prepare private pending lease, then wipe returned name/opaque copies. Display mappingName/byte count/unverified game state only; no payload/lease export or storage.
UI.invalidation: Username/password, encoding, configuration, text/mode changes and pagehide close pending lease; cancelled mode dialog preserves current pending selection.
UI.pagehide_fix: Reuse clearResult/closeModeDialog and reset status/text/input/consent, instead of only wiping memory while leaving a ready DOM claim.
UI.consumer: No game consumer called or implemented in this phase; no native mapping or executable/argv.

remaining: Game consumer/schema acceptance, argv/resources, official identity/opaque lifetime/update trust and target devices remain unverified.
